status: PROPOSED — owner review; legal topics limited to statutory requirements that genuinely apply to Nexus Ways' activity (owner instruction 28 Oct 2026); not legal advice
notes: One shared engine (desk/_tools/engines/marketgate.mjs) evaluates each market against its own configuration. Thresholds are freshness limits tied to each source's publication rhythm, not performance thresholds; no statistic has a pass value. Legal topics are questions for counsel, not conclusions.

statistics.name: Consumer price inflation, annual (monthly)
statistics.why: Nominal TRY figures are not comparable over time without inflation context.

statistics.name: CBRT one-week repo (policy) rate
statistics.why: Financing conditions and the opportunity cost of capital in TRY.

publishers: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

statistics.name: CBRT indicative USD/TRY rate
statistics.why: FX convention: TRY figures are converted only at a dated CBRT indicative rate.

publishers: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

statistics.fallback: Gate fails; no conversion is shown.

fx.convention: CBRT indicative buying rate on the observation date of the converted figure; maximum age 7 days (CNV-1); no cross rates; conflicting rates open a conflict and block the gate.

topics.question: Real-estate brokerage authorization: the Regulation on Real Estate Trade requires a brokerage authority certificate (taşınmaz ticareti yetki belgesi) for those who broker sales for a fee. Under which certificate (the owner's own, or a licensed firm's) does Nexus Ways present Istanbul projects and receive a commission?
topics.restriction: Until recorded, no Istanbul opportunity is published; research pages are unaffected.
topics.owner_record: Certificate number and holder, or counsel's memo reference.

topics.restriction: Until recorded, no Istanbul opportunity is published.
topics.owner_record: Official guidance or authorization reference, or counsel's memo reference.

topics.question: Advertising of off-plan (pre-paid) housing under the consumer-protection law and its pre-paid housing sales regulation: which statements must an advertisement for an unfinished project include or avoid?

activation_rule: A market may become ACTIVE only through `ingest.mjs activate-market --by owner`, which re-computes this gate and refuses unless (a) the computed gate passes for that market and (b) the registry entry M-MARKET-GATE is ACTIVE with RULES_APPROVED (owner approval of these rules). Each market is evaluated independently; one market's result never holds another.

fields: reviewer_role (per topic: accepted_roles; OWNER_OFFICIAL_REFERENCE = the owner records an official permit/certificate number or official rule reference)
review_record.rule: Only these records count as legal review. Evidence, research blocks or LEGAL FACT evidence are never treated as legal approval.

scope_note: Project-level advertising and media authorization comes from the written permission of each project's sales office (private permission records, checked per opportunity and per image within their channels, activities, media and dates). Market-level topics cover only statutory requirements on Nexus Ways' own activity. Site-wide items (privacy notice, not-advice wording, commission disclosure) are covered by the disclosure legal review, not by market gates. Per-project diligence (title, foreign-ownership eligibility, escrow, ADGM jurisdiction) is recorded as project evidence and in the decision report.
